public_rationale: The identifiable 5GW source measures projects scheduled to open in 2026. Zitron's sentence reads as a total across the announced pipeline, without that restriction. JLL reports a much larger construction pipeline, but its period and coverage differ. The narrower statistic therefore does not establish the claim as written, and the available comparison is insufficient for a clean contradiction.
limitations: The source supports a narrower statement about 2026 scheduled openings.
Broader construction totals cannot be substituted for an AI-only total without reconciling their coverage.

public_payload.normalized_proposition: Only about 5GW of the hundreds of gigawatts of announced AI data centers are actually under construction.

statement.excerpt: As I discussed a few weeks ago, despite everybody talking about the hundreds of gigawatts of data centers being built “to power AI,” only 5GW are actually “under construction,” with “under construction” meaning anything from “we’ve got some scaffolding up” to “we’re about to hand over the keys to the customer.”

from_speaker: As I discussed a few weeks ago
our_interpretation: The plain reading concerns capacity physically under construction across the announced AI data-center pipeline, regardless of scheduled opening year.
Treat 5GW as an approximate reported total, not a precisely measured engineering limit.
Use the latest completed quarter before publication, January–March 2026, for the contemporaneous construction snapshot.
GW means electrical capacity associated with data centers, not electricity generation or annual energy consumption.
criteria.support_condition: Comparable project tracking finds approximately 5GW physically under construction across the relevant announced pipeline, including projects opening after 2026.
criteria.contradiction_condition: Comparable tracking or a verified, non-overlapping project inventory establishes materially more or less than 5GW under construction in the same period and scope.

evidence.explanation: JLL's year-end 2025 report describes a 35GW North American construction pipeline and deliveries beyond 2026. This challenges treating Sightline's opening-year subtotal as an industry total, but the different period and broader data-center coverage prevent a direct contradiction.

public_payload.what_would_resolve: A dated early-2026 project inventory covering all scheduled opening years, with consistent AI scope, construction stages, and capacity units.
